item.title: Agentic Root-Cause Analysis for Wafer Excursions with Lot Genealogy Graphs
item.description: arXiv:2610.04211v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a multi-agent LLM system that traces wafer yield excursions back to tools and process steps using a lot genealogy graph built from MES and metrology data. On eight months of production data from a 300 mm fab the system shortens root-cause time by 41%.
item.dc:creator: Ana Ruiz, Bo Chen, Carla Diaz, Dev Patel
